cd /app/submission && python3 - << 'PY'
import random,time
r=random.Random(0)
Q=1024
pairs=[]
for _ in range(80000):
    a=r.getrandbits(Q)&r.getrandbits(Q)&r.getrandbits(Q)
    s=r.getrandbits(Q)
    pairs.append((a,s))
M=[0]*Q;Y=[0]*Q
t=time.time()
for af,sf in pairs:
    m=af
    while m:
        lsb=m&-m; M[lsb.bit_length()-1]+=1; m^=lsb
    s=sf
    while s:
        lsb=s&-s; Y[lsb.bit_length()-1]+=1; s^=lsb
print('time',time.time()-t)
PY
